title: Fusing Spectral Signatures and Activation Clustering for Backdoor Detection in Healthcare Imaging Models: Method, Implementation, and Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.14290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly deployed in healthcare imaging pipelines for diagnostic support, and training-time attacks against them are a named sector-level concern: healthcare-sector guidance identifies model poisoning and adversarial attacks as threats requiring dedicated defenses, while federal policy directs expanded AI vulnerability-detection tooling to critical infrastructure operators such as rural hospitals. Spectral signature analysis and activation clustering are two established backdoor detection methods routinely evaluated as independent baselines, but their outputs are not ordinarily combined, and reported detection performance on medical imaging benchmarks remains sparse relative to the natural-image setting. translated_title: 融合频谱签名与激活聚类用于医疗影像模型的后门检测：方法、实现与评估
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型日益被部署于医疗影像流程中用于诊断支持，而针对这些模型的训练时攻击已成为明确的行业级关注点：医疗行业指南将模型投毒和对抗性攻击列为需要专门防御的威胁，同时联邦政策要求为农村医院等关键基础设施运营者扩展AI漏洞检测工具。频谱签名分析和激活聚类是两种成熟的后门检测方法，通常作为独立基线进行评估，但它们的输出通常不会被组合使用，且相对于自然图像领域，在医学影像基准上报告的检测性能仍然稀少。本文做出三项贡献：一种分数级融合规则，将各类频谱排名与激活聚类标志组合为单一的逐样本投毒分数以及模型级一致性……（摘要原文截断，后续内容未提供）
tldr: 该论文提出一种分数级融合规则，将频谱签名分析与激活聚类两种后门检测方法相结合，用于医疗影像模型中投毒后门攻击的检测，并完成了方法的实现与评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a score-level fusion rule that combines spectral signature analysis with activation clustering for backdoor detection in healthcare imaging models, along with its implementation and evaluation.
